The target video is a vertical 9:16 e-commerce live-selling short video with warm indoor showroom lighting, soft depth of field, and a cozy premium atmosphere. All spoken lines delivered by <Subject 1> must have lip movements syllable-by-syllable synchronized with the driving audio, with natural jaw opening and closing that precisely matches each Chinese syllable's vowel and consonant shape, visible teeth and tongue positions consistent with natural Mandarin speech.
[Shot 1] Medium close-up in <Subject 3>, the warm-toned indoor showroom with dark wood panel walls, backlit glass display shelves softly blurred in the right background, and a green potted plant on the left. <Subject 1>, the young Asian woman with black low ponytail, champagne satin slip dress, and silver heart-pendant necklace, sits facing the camera with a bright, welcoming smile. She holds up a pair of <Subject 2> — the royal blue and hot pink color-block patent leather peep-toe d'Orsay pumps with gold crisscross straps and rhinestone circular ornament — in both hands at chest level, tilting them slightly toward the lens to present the toe design. She speaks energetically and enthusiastically to camera: her lips part wide on the opening greeting, lower jaw drops naturally on the emphatic exclamation "绝了", upper teeth show in a warm smile between phrases, and her mouth rounds on vowel sounds matching each spoken syllable, <d>[中文]姐妹们看过来！这双黑色真皮高跟鞋，质感真的绝了。</d> Her hands give the shoes a slight forward nudge as she finishes the line.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to an extreme macro close-up of <Subject 2>'s insole interior, filling the entire frame. The camera slowly tracks across the fine, grainy texture of the glossy patent leather insole, catching warm side highlights on the leather's natural sheen. A manicured finger with soft pink nail polish enters from the right edge, gently pressing into the padded insole to demonstrate cushioning, then traces slowly along the neat, even stitching where the insole meets the shoe upper. <Subject 1> continues speaking off-screen in the same energetic recommendation tone, <d>[中文]大家看这个皮面，细腻有光泽，缝线也非常工整；鞋垫软软的，久穿不累脚。</d> The finger presses and rubs the insole surface slowly to show softness and flexibility.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle shot from near floor level, looking up along <Subject 1>'s legs. The champagne satin dress hem falls naturally above the knees as she bends down, both hands guiding one foot into <Subject 2>, adjusting the shoe's collar around her heel to show the fit. The royal blue and hot pink patent leather of the pump catches the warm floor lighting, the sculptural flared block heel casting a soft shadow on the light wood floor. As she stands fully upright, the camera tilts slowly upward along her leg line to emphasize the leg-lengthening silhouette. <Subject 1> continues speaking off-screen with a pleased, confirming tone, <d>[中文]上脚超显腿长！而且你们看，皮质非常柔软，走路一点都不磨脚。</d> She takes a small step forward to show the shoe moving naturally with her foot.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts back to medium close-up of <Subject 1> facing camera in the same warm showroom setting. She looks directly at the lens with an enthusiastic, urgent promotional expression, both hands making energetic gestures — her left index finger pointing emphatically toward the lower-left corner of the screen, her right hand raised palm-up in a presenting motion. Her mouth opens wide on the urgent closing call-to-action, chin lifting slightly on the emphatic "手慢无", brows raised high, lips pressing together briefly between rapid-fire syllables, <d>[中文]现在下单限时秒杀，左下角购物车，手慢无哦，姐妹们！</d> A glowing golden shopping-cart sticker with radiating sparkles appears near the lower-left of frame, exactly where her finger is pointing.
